plan.md says 1,000 contracts settle each trading day, each on its own regional figure, and that same-day results correlate at an intraclass correlation of 0.0002 (95% interval 0 to 0.0005). Six weeks is 30 trading days, so 30,000 outcomes. At prices near 50 cents the standard error of the win rate would be 0.29 points if independent; the design effect 1 + 999 x ICC is 1.2 at 0.0002 and 1.5 at 0.0005, giving a standard error of 0.32 to 0.35 points, a 95% half-width of 0.62 to 0.69 points, and power of 0.89 to 0.81 to detect a 1-point edge at the 5% level.

Verdict: not established. Do not act on it yet.
